cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay while we finish returning the key. Put it on the table, please, not through the letterbox.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the table. There's nothing else to hand over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The object is here. The return isn't settled. Sit down before we decide whether you still need a key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can keep it if you want me checking the plants.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it for coming to see me. Sit down, please, and tell me when you're free. We're arranging a visit, not watering dates.
